title: 13:4 noise of the multitude . . . nations gathered together. The word noise in this verse may also be translated "voice," such as in "the voice of many people in the mountains." Elsewhere Isaiah likens the noise of a great multitude of people to the "noise of the seas" (17:12) and "the rushing of mighty waters" (17:12). The saints, or multitude, will gather together from the world's nations and kingdoms with the intent of building Zion (Matt. 24:30-31; D&C 29:7-11; 45:66; 103:22).
author: Tina M. Peterson
